scaffold.script_template:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
#
# {{agent_name}} - {{description}}
# Generated from learning-agent template
#

set -euo pipefail

readonly SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
readonly PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../../.." && pwd)"

# Source libraries
source "$PROJECT_ROOT/scripts/lib/agentstudio/agent-register.sh"

# Learning configuration
readonly AGENT_NAME="{{agent_name}}"
readonly LEARNING_RATE={{learning_rate}}
readonly MODEL_DIR="$SCRIPT_DIR/models"
readonly PATTERNS_FILE="$SCRIPT_DIR/patterns.jsonl"

mkdir -p "$MODEL_DIR"

#
# Initialize learning agent
#
init_agent() {
    local capabilities='{{capabilities_json}}'
    
    AGENT_ID=$(register_agent \
        "{{agent_class}}" \
        "$AGENT_NAME" \
        "1.0.0" \
        "$capabilities" \
        "{{description}}")
    
    echo "Learning agent registered: $AGENT_ID"
    
    # Initialize pattern storage
    if [[ ! -f "$PATTERNS_FILE" ]]; then
        touch "$PATTERNS_FILE"
    fi
}

#
# Extract patterns from data
#
extract_patterns() {
    local data="$1"
    
    echo "Extracting patterns from data..."
    
    # TODO: Implement pattern extraction logic
    # - Analyze data structure
    # - Identify recurring patterns
    # - Calculate pattern confidence
    # - Store patterns
    
    local patterns='[]'
    echo "$patterns"
}

#
# Process feedback
#
process_feedback() {
    local feedback="$1"
    
    echo "Processing feedback..."
    
    # TODO: Implement feedback processing
    # - Parse feedback
    # - Update model weights
    # - Adjust learning rate
    # - Save updated model
    
    local timestamp=$(date +%s)
    echo "{\"timestamp\":$timestamp,\"feedback\":$feedback}" >> "$PATTERNS_FILE"
}

#
# Update model
#
update_model() {
    echo "Updating model with learning rate: $LEARNING_RATE"
    
    # TODO: Implement model update logic
    # - Load current model
    # - Apply learning updates
    # - Validate model performance
    # - Save new model version
}

#
# Main learning loop
#
run_agent() {
    echo "Starting $AGENT_NAME..."
    echo "Learning rate: $LEARNING_RATE"
    
    init_agent
    
    local iteration=0
    
    while true; do
        iteration=$((iteration + 1))
        
        agent_heartbeat "$AGENT_ID"
        
        # TODO: Collect new data
        # TODO: Extract patterns
        # TODO: Process feedback
        # TODO: Update model every N iterations
        
        if [[ $((iteration % {{update_interval}})) -eq 0 ]]; then
            update_model
        fi
        
        sleep {{check_interval:-60}}
    done
}

# Run if executed directly
if [[ "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" == "${0}" ]]; then
    run_agent
fi
